title: Continue restores the saved objective
caption: A later-day save now shows its objective after Continue, even when onboarding storage is fresh. The initial train introduction still keeps its goal hidden.

sections.title: First diagnostic attempt
sections.caption: The checker encountered a reload race before it could assert the restored goal. Retained as a failed diagnostic, not a passing baseline.

sections.title: Reproduced: saved goal stays hidden
sections.caption: Desktop Continue restores the text but leaves it held and hidden. The assertion fails with no game page errors; this attempt stops before phone.

sections.title: Corrected: desktop and phone
sections.caption: Fresh train keeps its controls-first introduction. Continuing the day-two office save now displays the saved goal on both sizes.
